_meta.note: Translations of the most-used Article 50 disclosure labels. Six EU official languages included here. For the full 24-language set, use the Disclos generator at https://www.disclos.eu/tools/article-50-disclosure-generator. PRs welcome to extend this file.

ai_chat_interaction.en: You are chatting with an AI assistant.
ai_chat_interaction.fr: Vous discutez avec un assistant IA.
ai_chat_interaction.es: Está chateando con un asistente de IA.
ai_chat_interaction.it: Stai chattando con un assistente IA.

ai_generated_content.en: This content was generated by an AI system.
ai_generated_content.de: Dieser Inhalt wurde von einem KI-System erzeugt.
ai_generated_content.fr: Ce contenu a été généré par un système d'IA.
ai_generated_content.es: Este contenido fue generado por un sistema de IA.
ai_generated_content.it: Questo contenuto è stato generato da un sistema di IA.
ai_generated_content.nl: Deze inhoud is gegenereerd door een AI-systeem.

deepfake_disclosure.en: This content has been artificially generated or manipulated.
deepfake_disclosure.de: Dieser Inhalt wurde künstlich erzeugt oder verändert.
deepfake_disclosure.fr: Ce contenu a été généré ou manipulé artificiellement.
deepfake_disclosure.es: Este contenido ha sido generado o manipulado artificialmente.
deepfake_disclosure.it: Questo contenuto è stato generato o manipolato artificialmente.
deepfake_disclosure.nl: Deze inhoud is kunstmatig gegenereerd of gemanipuleerd.

emotion_recognition_disclosure.en: This service uses AI to analyse emotional cues.
emotion_recognition_disclosure.de: Dieser Dienst verwendet KI zur Analyse emotionaler Hinweise.
emotion_recognition_disclosure.fr: Ce service utilise l'IA pour analyser les signaux émotionnels.
emotion_recognition_disclosure.es: Este servicio utiliza IA para analizar señales emocionales.
emotion_recognition_disclosure.it: Questo servizio utilizza l'IA per analizzare segnali emotivi.
emotion_recognition_disclosure.nl: Deze dienst gebruikt AI om emotionele signalen te analyseren.

biometric_categorisation_disclosure.en: This service uses AI to categorise biometric characteristics.
biometric_categorisation_disclosure.de: Dieser Dienst verwendet KI zur Kategorisierung biometrischer Merkmale.
biometric_categorisation_disclosure.fr: Ce service utilise l'IA pour catégoriser des caractéristiques biométriques.
biometric_categorisation_disclosure.es: Este servicio utiliza IA para categorizar características biométricas.
biometric_categorisation_disclosure.it: Questo servizio utilizza l'IA per categorizzare caratteristiche biometriche.
biometric_categorisation_disclosure.nl: Deze dienst gebruikt AI om biometrische kenmerken te categoriseren.

how_to_contribute: Open a PR adding a language code under each label. Use the official terminology from the Regulation's translated version on EUR-Lex where available. Mark uncertain translations with a comment so a reviewer can verify against the official text.
